chunks.text: Anthropic's shares fell on Friday, a day after its stock market debut, the BBC reports. On Thursday, trading started at $111.50 and the stock closed up 17% at $97.17. On Friday it dropped more than 12% at one point, to about $85, near the $83 IPO price. It closed down 8.5%, reversing half of Thursday's gains. The Nasdaq plunged 5.3%, and the S&P 500 and the Dow entered correction territory. The BBC cites concerns over AI spending, with more than $1 trillion spent in the last year by a few major tech companies. For the Gulf, watch whether investor nerves change the pace of AI and data center projects.
